carousels.campaign_goal: Explain what an interactive website should do for a buyer.
carousels.lesson: Interaction should capture attention, explain the offer, sustain engagement, and make the next action clearer.
carousels.caption:
An interactive website should do more than look different.

The job is to make the offer easier to understand and the experience easier to remember.

A useful interaction has a purpose: capture attention, explain the product, keep the buyer engaged, then make the next action obvious.

That is the difference between adding motion and designing an experience.

carousels.campaign_goal: Teach the structure of a strong digital product launch.
carousels.lesson: A launch experience should move from positioning to design, interaction, and a clear launch path.
carousels.caption:
A product launch site is not just a homepage with a new product on it.

The experience needs a sequence.

Start with the reason to care. Show the product clearly. Reveal the details that justify the value. Use interaction where it improves understanding. Then give the buyer a clear next step.

Good launch design turns information into a story people can follow.
